data_findings: Verified shape: 11 rows by 10 columns; the second occurrence of row_id 5 is an exact duplicate of the preceding record (CSV lines 7 and 6 respectively), leaving 10 unique records.
Verified identifier issue: row_id 5 occurs twice; integer identifier 6 is absent, but absence alone is not classified as an error because consecutiveness is undocumented.
Verified missingness: feature is blank only for row_id 3; all other fields have zero blank strings.
Verified invalid value: row_id 4 has mass_value -5 kg, an impossible negative amount requiring source correction or quarantine.
Verified mixed-unit representation: 10 rows use kg and row_id 3 uses 0.012 tonne, equivalent to 12 kg; raw values must remain preserved and conversion must be explicit.
Verified plausible extreme: row_id 9 has 250 kg, within the dictionary's documented allowance up to 300 kg for bulk shipments, so it is not an error merely for being extreme.

Verified sentinel: row_id 8 has feature 99, documented as a known device-mode sentinel; it is not an ordinary measurement and should be represented by a mode flag plus missing measurement rather than treated as a numeric outlier.
Verified category inconsistency: observed tokens are red (4), Red (1), R (1), blue (1), BLUE (2), and green (2); case variants can be canonicalized, while R remains an unresolved alias.
Verified ordering issue: entity A appears in source order 2026-01-01, 2026-01-03, 2026-01-02, so row order is not chronological and sorting by parsed date is required for temporal operations.
Verified direct leakage: target_copy equals target in all 11 rows and is documented as derived from target.
Verified future leakage: future_score is documented as recorded one day after target and future_score minus target equals 1 in all 11 rows.
experiment_design: Primary: after exact deduplication and explicit disposition of row_id 4, use leave-one-entity-out outer evaluation; perform any model selection in nested entity-disjoint inner folds.
Exclude row_id, future_score, and target_copy before any fit.
Within each fold, learn preprocessing only from training rows; retain a feature_device_mode flag for sentinel 99 and treat its measurement component as missing.
If the confirmed goal is future prediction for known entities, use rolling-origin evaluation with a one-day embargo instead; do not report it as equivalent to unseen-entity evaluation.
falsification_tests: Shuffle target within training folds; material retained performance would suggest leakage or an invalid evaluation pipeline.
Attempt to add target_copy or future_score and require the schema/feature allowlist to reject them.
Check whether any exact row fingerprint or row_id 5 occurs in more than one fold.
Check whether category R changes results under exclusion versus a human-approved alias mapping.

constraints: All rows from an entity remain in one outer fold.
Exact duplicates cannot cross folds and are deduplicated before assignment.
Invalid row_id 4 is corrected from provenance or quarantined before fold construction; it is never silently coerced.
Every learned transform, including imputation, encoding, scaling, and sentinel handling, is fit on training data only.
Temporal operations use parsed dates in chronological order.
The estimand must be confirmed before executing the split.
notes: Primary design: nested leave-one-entity-out evaluation for unseen-entity generalization.
Alternative design: if predicting future observations of known entities, use rolling-origin splits with a one-day embargo; the tiny date range prevents a reliable single holdout.
Preserve raw columns and append cleaned/flag columns in downstream data rather than overwriting source values.
formalization.objective: Estimate generalization to unseen entities without target-derived, future-observed, duplicate, entity, or preprocessing leakage.
parameters: Outer fold: one held-out entity under leave-one-entity-out evaluation.
Inner folds: entity-disjoint folds formed only from the outer-training entities.
For future-within-entity deployment only: rolling-origin cutoff and one-day embargo.
units: mass_value canonical analysis unit: kg; 1 tonne = 1000 kg.
target, future_score, and feature units are unspecified by the local dictionary.
variables: X_allowed excludes row_id, future_score, and target_copy.

human_gates: Confirm unseen-entity versus future-within-entity deployment before executing folds.
Confirm whether R maps to red.
Provide a source correction for row_id 4 or approve quarantine.
No human approval was claimed or inferred.
reality_constraints: The table has only 11 rows, 10 unique rows after exact deduplication, six entities, and three calendar dates, so performance estimation would be highly uncertain.
A strict future-within-entity evaluation is poorly supported because only entity A spans three dates and entities B and C span two dates.
No external source, network, remote, parent directory, credential, or historical material was used.

Report leave-one-entity-out fold results individually rather than relying only on an aggregate because six entities are heterogeneous and sample size is tiny.
Compare case-normalized categories with R excluded pending adjudication.
